content:
zoe_cs: Sophie from ClearSight reports a brief flood of 429s right after onboarding tests. They run 40 stateless workers that call /embed at startup. Can infra/SDK look?

 sophie_support: Behavior: within 5-10s of deploy we see many 429s, then things normalize after ~2 minutes. Logs: 

 sophie_support: ```
2026-06-01T08:15:10Z INFO SDK init complete
2026-06-01T08:15:10Z WARN response 429 rate_limit_exceeded
2026-06-01T08:15:10Z INFO retrying attempt=1 delay=0ms
2026-06-01T08:15:11Z WARN response 429 rate_limit_exceeded
2026-06-01T08:15:11Z ERROR pool: no healthy upstreams
```

 marc_sdk: Which SDK version and config?

 zoe_cs: Using quickstart bundle sdk-py v0.9.3 with defaults. No custom backoff.

 marc_sdk: v0.9.3 has prewarm enabled for embeddings and no client-side jitter in quickstart snippets. We changed quickstart in v0.10 to include randomized warmup.

 ian_infra: Gateway sees synchronized bursts from same API key, short-lived TCPs (keepalive disabled). That trips our adaptive limiter which returns 429 to protect backend.

 oliver_sre: Recommend customer-side fixes first: enable keepalive, add small random startup delay across instances, and reduce concurrent prefetch. Example: 

 marc_sdk: ```py
import random, time
delay = random.uniform(0, 1.2)
time.sleep(delay)
client = Client(max_concurrency=6, keepalive=True)
client.embed(batch)
```

 sophie_support: We'll have the customer try that and report back (ETA 45m).

 oliver_sre: Server-side quick mitigation: canary a short onboarding grace so new keys get a lenient limiter for first 2 minutes. Also return Retry-After headers consistently for 429s.

 deploybot: Rollout planned 2026-06-01T09:00 UTC: sdkgateway canary (10%) enabling onboarding-grace and consistent Retry-After.

 zoe_cs: Action items: (1) Sophie to apply keepalive + jitter and retest (ETA 45m). (2) Marc to note quickstart update and patch docs (ETA PR today). (3) Oliver to canary onboarding-grace (ETA 09:00 UTC). (4) Support to draft KB note on warmup patterns (ETA EOD).

 sophie_support: Update: after enabling keepalive and 0-1.2s jitter across workers, only 1-2 429s observed, system stable. Thanks!

 zoe_cs: Closing for now. Reopen if it recurs.

 help_bot: KB draft created: "Onboarding warmup: avoid synchronized bursts".
